issue.body:
Currently, the `exception_handlers` argument of `Starlette` app class accepts a mapping of exception types to handler functions. I'd like to propose that, in addition to that, it could accept a single callable which would manage the error types internally.

The reason for this is that it would then be possible to manage the different handlers for different error types using the [`functools.singledispatch`](https://docs.python.org/3.7/library/functools.html#functools.singledispatch) decorator. The only problem is that the signature of that callable would have to be `func(exc, request)`, which is the opposite of the individual handlers accepted in the mapping. (Alternatively, would it be too difficult to change their signatures too? :thinking: )

Thoughts?
issue.title: Proposal: Pass a single callable for exception_handlers
